title: Khép kênh hội thoại và luồng Execute của AgentOS
statusMeaning: Waiting for prerequisite evidence; no execution has started.
why: Verify the real channel-to-controller-to-Core event path and execute sessions, including provider custody, delivery acknowledgement, retry and a Core outage.
acceptance: Each enabled provider has a declared connect, inbound, reply and disconnect contract.
The money/chat path behavior during Core outage matches the accepted product promise; durable outbox catches up without duplicates.
Owner/recipient payload rules, send window, quota, template and stop/handoff gates execute in code.
Test messages are sent only to explicitly authorized test destinations.
Execution uses the applied context; setup/test histories do not become live customer messages.

goalDraft.goal: Khép kênh hội thoại và luồng Execute của AgentOS
includes: Khép kênh hội thoại và luồng Execute của AgentOS
Exactly two modules: Chatbot and Accounting; supporting AgentOS flows only.
excludes: Unrelated source, shared credentials and production deployment
Treating a fixture, a mock or an old receipt as a completed live action
Standalone Scheduling, Knowledge Hub, Sales Copilot and broad SMB workbenches

doneWhen.evidence: One bounded source receipt closes the named behavior gap on its session branch.
The required repository gates pass at the delivered head.
Positive and negative API cases read back the resulting state at the served head.
The corresponding real user journey is walked at the delivered head.

goalDraft.sourceRef: user:2026-09-05 final scope: exactly two modules, one accounting and one chatbot; business flows included; Template App later

execution.liveEffects: No live effect is authorized by banking. At activation use environment declarations and the exact mission scope; real outbound messages require explicit user authorization.
execution.seeding: A dedicated owner and stranger, per-flow run namespace, deterministic IDs, exact marker/owner checks on reuse and dependency-safe cleanup. Fixture history is labelled and cannot stand for Test, Apply, payment or provider success. Create fixtures only for the selected Chatbot and Accounting modules; knowledge fixtures are supporting inputs, not a third module.
execution.failureRouting: Read the executing operator stop and current .claude/routing.json; this card defines no alternate routes.
execution.publication: If source is changed, include git.publish only in the activated scope and derive all required gates. Backend business changes also require business.reconcile where a published promise applies.
